headline: The 152-second session generated 41 comments and 34 questions across two products, with all compliance and fact alerts corrected.
highlights: All 3 required points were covered for Hydra Barrier Cream during its 126 seconds of broadcast.
The high-severity compliance alert for the skin ageing claim was corrected in 5783 milliseconds.
Fact alerts for price and ingredient amount were both successfully corrected.
watch_outs: Deep Hydration Ampoule broadcast for 26 seconds against a planned 600 seconds and missed 2 required points.
The ingredient amount correction took 20816 milliseconds to resolve after stating 10% niacinamide instead of 4% niacinamide.
A total of 7 product question groups and 1 shipping question group remain unanswered.
follow_ups: Answer the 4 unanswered question groups for Hydra Barrier Cream concerning makeup use, dry skin, pregnancy, and eczema.
Answer the 3 unanswered question groups for Deep Hydration Ampoule regarding stinging, vitamin C compatibility, and morning use.
Reply to the 1 unanswered shipping question asking 'Do you ship to Malaysia?'.
